rows.label: tlk70000076_03_msg0001
rows.name:
What's the Imperial Army
doing in Gula, you say?

rows.label: tlk70000076_03_msg0002
rows.name:
Well, we're here to protect
Yuugo-sama, of course.

rows.label: tlk70000076_03_msg0003
rows.name:
But, actually, it seems there's
another reason, as well.

rows.label: tlk70000076_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Rumor says some military personnel are
secretly studying Gula's population,
economy, and even military strength.

rows.label: tlk70000076_03_msg0005
rows.name:
Superbia is trying to forge friendly
ties with Gula. Apparently these
investigations are part of that.

rows.label: tlk70000076_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Friendly ties or not, it's still
diplomacy. I suppose some cards
are needed.

rows.label: tlk70000076_03_msg0007
rows.name:
As long as I've got this gun, I don't
need any fussy little tricks! Hahaha!
